cut_items.item: Teammates who have the branch checked out should run git fetch and git reset --hard origin/<branch> after the push; a normal git pull would merge old and new history together and cause trouble
If the branch has an open PR, the force-push updates it, and review comments on old commits can become outdated
Alternative that avoids force: merge the target branch into the feature branch (adds a merge commit, no force needed)

added_items.item: If the push fails with a 'stale info' error, the remote changed after your last fetch; fetch again and repeat the check
If unknown commits show up in the remote, don't force push; rebase onto origin/<branch> again or ask the author
Recovery option: you can often recover overwritten commits via git reflog locally or the remote host's branch history
